tone_statements.citation: Jungraithmayr, Herrmann. 1964/65. Materialien zur Kenntnis des Chip, Montol, Gerka und Burrum (Südplateau, Nordnigerien). Afrika und Übersee 48: 161-182.
tone_statements.quote: ... Montol gekennzeichnet. (Reg.) = Nomen in Regensstellung. (Rkt.) = Nomen in Rektumstellung. Zur Anordnung und Schreibung der Materialien Die Materialien der vier Sprachen werden jeweils in zwei Teilen geboten: A. zur Laut ... (á) Hochton, (à) Tiefton. Unbezeichnete Silben bzw. Vokale haben Mittelton. An Bewegungstönen kommen vor: Hoch-Tief-fallend (a), Tief-Hoch-steigend (ă), Hoch-Mittel-fallend (á) ...
tone_statements.translation: ... [forms] marked as Montol. (Reg.) = noun in head (regens) position. (Rkt.) = noun in dependent (rectum) position. On the arrangement and transcription of the materials: The materials of the four languages are each presented in two parts: A. on the sound[s and forms] ... (á) high tone, (à) low tone. Unmarked syllables or vowels have mid tone. The following contour tones occur: high-low falling (â), low-high rising (ǎ), high-mid falling (á..) ...
tone_statements.locator: Introductory section 'Zur Anordnung und Schreibung der Materialien' (abbreviations and transcription conventions preceding the four language sections), within pp. 161-163 of AuU 48 (1964/65)
tone_statements.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
tone_statements.n_tones: 3 level (H acute, M unmarked, L grave) + contour tones (HL falling, LH rising,…

tone.says: First-hand tone-marked material (fieldwork 1962) with an explicit marking convention stated once for all four languages incl. Montol: (á) Hochton = high, (à) Tiefton = low, unmarked syllables/vowels = Mittelton (mid); contour tones ('Bewegungstöne') listed: Hoch-Tief-fallend, Tief-Hoch-steigend, Hoch-Mittel-fallend, Mittel-Tief-fallend (list continues beyond the snippet) - i.e. three level tones plus at least four contours; a later snippet notes a suffix whose tone is variable (cf. p. 175).
